where: cargo test -p hir-expand on origin/main (136432aa02), pinned nightly
what: hir-expand`s test target does not compile: `error: invalid format string: unmatched `}` found` at crates/hir-expand/src/budget_tests.rs:216 (`assert!(.., "ends in `}`")`). `cargo test -p hir-def -p hir-expand -p intern` therefore ran nothing of the three.
cost: one wasted run (about 4 minutes) and hir-expand`s tests not run for a change to its builtin macros
cause: a `}` in an assert message; cargo`s rustc reads the message as a format string
whys: the test target fails to compile under cargo
nothing compiles test targets with cargo before a merge
class: test code only one of the two builders compiles
prevention: not built: `cargo check --tests` of touched crates in the gate while cargo is the dev-loop builder
workaround: run the other crates` tests without `-p hir-expand`
